Wales Concludes WXV Campaign With Dominant Win

Wales head coach Sean Lynn praised the attitude and effort of his players following a 29-5 victory over Japan in the WXV Global Series. The completed fixture marked the second consecutive win for Wales against Japan, culminating a strong run of results in the cross-continental tournament.

According to the source-confirmed match report, the performance sealed three victories out of four fixtures for Wales during the competition. The squad's strong finish follows a challenging period for the program as they look toward future international cycles.

Building Toward the 2029 Rugby World Cup

Following the conclusion of the fixture, Lynn outlined the broader strategic context for the national team. He reported that the squad has established a formal roadmap leading toward the 2029 Rugby World Cup.

  • Strategic Goals: The long-term plan is designed to help the team bounce back from a difficult, winless campaign in 2025.
  • Tournament Performance: Securing three wins in the WXV Global Series provides positive momentum for the program's ongoing development.
